title: Seven habits of a field kit that survives the season
intro: Nothing here is expensive. Everything here has saved a sampling campaign at least once.

add_content_to_page.add_paragraph: After enough seasons, the kit stops being a list of instruments and becomes a set of habits. These are the seven we keep returning to.

add_items_to_list: **Label twice.** Once on the container, once on the lid. Labels fail in different ways.
**Carry a spare for every connector.** Connectors fail more often than sensors.
**Log the environment.** Temperature, humidity and light explain most mystery drift.
**Write the time you stopped trusting a series.** Future-you needs the exact moment.
**Keep a paper notebook.** Batteries end; the notebook does not.
**Pack for the walk back.** The return trip is when things break.
**Leave the kit better than you found it.** The next team inherits your habits.

add_image.image_alt: An open field case with instruments and labelled bags
add_image.image_caption: A kit packed the night before, which is half the battle.

add_content_to_page.add_paragraph: The list is not a standard. It is a memory aid, and it changes every year as the equipment does.
